```text
$ sccfm-cli inventory devices asa shun --help

Usage: sccfm-cli inventory devices asa shun [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Manage shun entries on ASA devices.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  add     Shun (block) one or more source IP addresses on ASA devices.
  clear   Disable all active shuns and clear shun statistics on ASA devices.
  remove  Remove one or more shun entries from ASA devices.
  show    Display active shun entries on ASA devices.
```
